name: ab_1060k_split128
bootstrap:
import sys,torch,runpy,json,os
mode=sys.argv.pop(1)
torch.cuda.init()
if 'gc70' in mode:torch.cuda.set_per_process_memory_fraction(1.0)
print('allocator_provenance '+json.dumps(dict(mode=mode,config=os.environ.get('PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF'),memory_fraction=1.0 if 'gc70' in mode else None,backend=torch.cuda.memory.get_allocator_backend(),max_split_size=torch.cuda.memory_stats()['max_split_size'])),flush=True)
sys.argv[0]='tools/experiments/ptv3_memory_v1.py'
runpy.run_path(sys.argv[0],run_name='__main__')
